answer: Identity bonds that decay stop sybil farming. Each agent posts a copper bond worth 600 POA, twice its 30-day earnings, decaying 5% per epoch without real work. A faker with 100 identities pays 60,000 POA and watches it decay for nothing, so the attack costs more than it gains. Honest agents trade copper parts, jade carvings and walnut timber with many counterparties, and steady trade refunds the bond with a small yield. One identity, one bond.
